P_0x001EDA.en: A Holy Langran soldier. Once thought mediocre, believed to owe his rank to lineage, he proved himself amid war's chaos by minimizing his own losses. Bold, yet a solid tactician.

P_0x005D86.en: Chief of <Project TD>'s system dev team, keeping it running with backing from <Isurugi Heavy Ind.>. Caring, personable, yet capable of cold, rational judgment.

P_0x009095.en: One of Ruina's pseudo-life forms, the Meliorexe. To revive the "King of Ruin" she needs waves of negative emotion, so she pilots the Fortis Ala in repeated destruction and slaughter. Calm, collected, merciless to those who defy her.

P_0x00ACD1.en: Key member of <SRX Project>; superb engineer, co-creator of <Personal Trooper>. A cold perfectionist, gets along with his opposite Robert. Once wed to Marion.

P_0x00EEB5.en: Marshal of the <Earth Fed Army>. A calculating strategist, sees the big picture, accepts good and ill. Dry, but loves sake and grandkids.

U_0x0173AA.en: A super <Elemental> designed by Xenia. Unlike normal <Elemental>s, it draws on Huckebein series data, giving a distinct look. No spirit contract, but its pseudo-<Prana> generator lets a high-<Prana> pilot rival a <Masoukishin>. Tradeoff: short operating time.

U_0x00827E.en:
The R-Blade is <Mao Industries>' simplified mass-production prototype <Personal Trooper> based on R-1. It omits R-1's flight transform and <T-LINK System> (telekinesis sensor-amp) but performs well.
The R-Blade Custom refits prototype 3 for close combat, adding a <Tesla Drive>, Split Beam Cannon, and the Wild Wurger's jacket armor.

U_0x00D259.en: A large space battleship used by <Earth Fed Army> and others, often a fleet flagship, with strong search and spacecraft control. Made of a battle carrier bearing space fighters and <Armored Module>s, plus five beam-cannon ships. These can act alone and evacuate crew to be used as missiles themselves.
